snippet.title: Jump Man Announcement Trailer - PlayStation 5/4, Xbox Series
snippet.description:
Available on Xbox Series Feb 20th, 2025. PlayStation March 6th, 2025.

A highly addictive endless jumper you can play either solo or with friends for couch multiplayer fun! Chain combos, use power-ups, score as high as you can and climb your way up the leaderboards. Attack your opponents with special items while dodging their attacks and see who makes it in the end!

Trailer music: "Taste my Groove" by Mike Franklyn
